## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the local checks and platforms you used. Include relevant commands and
their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated generated files.
- [ ] Tests or documentation cover the changed behavior, or I explain why they do not.
- [ ] Command output, error handling, and exit status remain appropriate for scripts and pipes.
- [ ] I did not add model files, caches, credentials, or private data.
- [ ] I updated English documentation and any affected translations.
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
